title: Tofu Greek salad
summary: Tofu Greek salad is a mediterranean dinner built around firm tofu and cucumber, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Cook firm tofu for Tofu Greek salad in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm cherry tomatoes alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss cucumber with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.
Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Tofu Greek salad straight away. Taste Tofu Greek salad before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
